## 10. Key Architectural Observations

### 10.1 Multi-Tenancy Architecture
- Every single API entity carries a `company_id` field for strict tenant isolation
- All queries are scoped by `company_id` — no cross-tenant data leakage possible
- Tenant = Company in OnsiteTeams terminology

### 10.2 Data Persistence Patterns
- **Soft Deletes**: `delete` (boolean/int) flag appears on almost every model
- **No hard deletes** — data is permanently retained for audit trails
- **UUID Primary Keys**: All IDs are UUID v4 format (e.g., `4d6fc487-5cf8-4826-8fd3-1c1f5f1d7660`)
- **ISO 8601 Timestamps**: `created` and `updated` in UTC on all entities

### 10.3 API Design Patterns
- **Versioned API**: `/apis/v3/` prefix — v1/v2 exist historically
- **RPC-style naming**: `/apis/v3/add/resource`, `/apis/v3/get/resource`, `/apis/v3/update/resource`
- **Not pure REST**: Uses action-verb URLs rather than HTTP method semantics alone
- **`monkey_patch_*` Pattern**: Denormalized join objects embedded in responses
  - Avoids N+1 queries by bundling related data
  - Prefix: `monkey_patch_` (e.g., `monkey_patch_creator`, `monkey_patch_project`)
  - These are read-only computed fields, not sent in POST requests

### 10.4 Authentication Model
- Cookie/session based authentication (no Bearer tokens in observed headers)
- JWT or session token stored in cookie
- API server at `api.onsiteteams.in` (separate from frontend `web.onsiteteams.com`)

### 10.5 Indian Market Compliance
- GST fields: `gstin`, `address_gst`, `gst_number`, `state_of_supply`
- Identity fields: `aadhar_card_number`, `pan_card_number`
- Labor compliance: `esi_number`, `uan_number` (EPFO)
- Tax deduction: TDS tracking in finance module

### 10.6 Universal Approval Workflow
- Approval pipeline templates configurable per feature type
- Multi-level approval with role-based approvers
- Fields: `min`, `max`, `normal` (amount thresholds for routing)
- Applied across: invoices, expenses, purchase orders, etc.

### 10.7 Real-Time Features
- Notification system observed (push/SMS/email)
- Comment threads on entities
- Likely uses WebSocket or polling for live updates

### 10.8 File Management
- Multipart file upload endpoints observed
- Photos stored as arrays of URLs: `aadhar_photos`, `pan_photos`
- Document attachment on multiple entity types
